chow.definition:
n. informal terms for a meal
n. breed of medium-sized dogs with a thick coat and fluffy curled tails and distinctive blue-black tongues; believed to have originated in northern China

chow-chow.translation:
adj. 各式各样的，什锦的
n. 什锦菜；食品；一顿饭菜; (水果等制成的)中国蜜饯

chowchow.definition:
n. chopped pickles in mustard sauce
n. a Chinese preserve of mixed fruits and ginger
chowchow.translation: n. 什锦酱菜, 中国蜜饯, 食物

chowder.definition: n. a thick soup or stew made with milk and bacon and onions and potatoes

chowders.translation: n. 杂烩( chowder的名词复数 )

chowk.translation: （城市交叉路口处的）集市广场

chowry.definition: n. A whisk to keep off files, used in the East Indies.

chows.definition:
n. the imperial dynasty of China from 1122 to 221 BC; notable for the rise of Confucianism and Taoism
n. informal terms for a meal
n. breed of medium-sized dogs with a thick coat and fluffy curled tails and distinctive blue-black tongues; believed to have originated in northern China
chows.translation: n. 原产地中国的狗（体壮, 有褐或黑色厚毛, 舌为深蓝色）( chow的复数形式 )

chowtime.translation: n. <美口>进餐时间,开饭时间
